name: Local dev page needing a synthetic user-gesture click

clickAndVerify.description: Click a button on a local dev page over a raw CDP WebSocket (bypasses ctx.session, for a throwaway browser instance the harness's own Session did not discover) and return before/after state. Use for a page that needs a real user gesture (e.g. resuming an AudioContext) and cannot take synthetic input via macOS assistive access.

urlIncludes.description: Substring to match the target page's url, e.g. "5173".

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click.

before.description: JS expression evaluated before the click, e.g. a JSON.stringify of the state to compare.

after.description: JS expression evaluated after the click + delay.

delayMs.description: Wait between click and the after read, default 2000.

returns.description: {before, after}, the raw values of the before/after expressions.
